_note: Synthetic incident history for the failure memory (20 incidents). All invented.

incidents.summary: Carrier tracking endpoint stopped returning shipment_status and eta at the top level. Fields moved under a tracking object and the time became epoch seconds.
Warehouse reservation call timed out but the bay was actually held. Retrying created a second hold.

fix.rule: after a timeout, read reservations by shipment before any retry

incidents.summary: Carrier renamed booking status values from lowercase words to uppercase codes.
Hospital receiving rejected delivery updates without a timezone on the arrival time.

fix.rule: always send arrival times in UTC with an explicit offset

incidents.summary: Tracking response no longer has a flat eta string. Arrival is now a unix timestamp nested in a tracking block.
Carrier status field vanished from the top level after an API upgrade. A state value now sits inside a tracking object in capital letters.
Booking lookup started returning 404 for shipments that were booked. The carrier moved bookings to a new path.

fix.rule: read the bookings list by shipment id before concluding a booking is missing

incidents.summary: Carrier rate limited us during a mass cancellation and returned 429 for route searches.

fix.rule: back off and retry route search, never rebook until the search succeeds

incidents.summary: Carrier booking confirmation arrived twice with different booking ids after a gateway retry.

fix.rule: send a stable Idempotency-Key on every booking

incidents.summary: ETA came back in local time with no zone, which made arrivals look hours early.

fix.rule: treat carrier times as UTC only when they carry an explicit offset

incidents.summary: Route list returned cancelled flights for a few minutes after the cancellation.
Capacity endpoint returned bays as a count in one release and as a list of ids in the next.
Reservation was created but the response was lost in transit, so the agent tried again and held a second bay.

fix.rule: after a lost response, read reservations by shipment before any retry

incidents.summary: Warehouse accepted a reservation window that started in the past and silently shifted it.

fix.rule: verify the held window matches the requested window

incidents.summary: Reservation status changed from held to HELD_CONFIRMED after a vendor update.
Cold storage bay was released at midnight by an automatic cleanup and the shipment arrived with no space.

fix.rule: re-read the reservation shortly before arrival

incidents.summary: Hospital portal began rejecting delivery updates that used a status word it did not know.

fix.rule: use only the status words the portal lists

incidents.summary: Hospital delivery record kept the old arrival time after our update returned success.

fix.rule: read the delivery back and compare the arrival time

incidents.summary: Hospital endpoint timed out during a maintenance window and the update may or may not have landed.

fix.rule: read the delivery record before sending the update again

incidents.summary: Arrival time sent as epoch seconds was read as milliseconds and landed in 1970.

fix.rule: send arrival times as ISO 8601 UTC strings
